description: SENDS REAL MESSAGES TO REAL PEOPLE. This is irreversible and costs credits. It requires an approval_token from review_campaign_readiness and explicit operator authorization for this exact launch. In an interactive current turn where the human explicitly asked to send this campaign, in a session they signed in to themselves (OAuth), pass operator_authorized_this_launch=true instead of asking them to copy/paste the server phrase. With an API key that flag is refused: the operator must type the confirmation phrase. Never set that flag for a scheduled or background run, standing instructions, prior approval, enthusiasm, or inferred intent. Never infer approval. Never generate the confirmation yourself. The exact confirmation phrase remains supported for every client. Never reuse an approval issued for a different campaign or a different size.

all_textable_numbers.description: SMS only. Must match the readiness review. When true, queue one separate text to every approved textable phone on each selected lead.

approval_token.description: The token from review_campaign_readiness. Single-use and short-lived.

channel.description: Must match the channel the readiness review approved. Default 'sms'; 'email' launches email-only.

confirmation.description: The exact confirmation phrase from the readiness review, as the operator typed it. Optional only when operator_authorized_this_launch=true in a signed-in (OAuth) session; always required with an API key.

from_address_id.description: Email channel only: the same from_address_id the readiness review was run with (the approval binds to it).

from_number.description: SMS channel only: the same outbound number the readiness review was run with. Omit for automatic sender routing.

lead_ids.description: Must match the subset that was reviewed and approved.

operator_authorized_this_launch.description: Set true only when the authenticated human operator explicitly asked to launch this exact campaign in the current interactive turn of a session they signed in to (OAuth). Refused with an API key. Never set for scheduled/background execution, standing preferences, prior approvals, or inferred intent.

name: launch_approved_campaign
title: Launch an approved campaign
